messages:
maria: Quick sync — I'm pushing a small terraform change to add an annotation that the rotation webhook expects: `redwood.com/rotation-route: service-account`. 

alex: nice. which service? link pls

maria: - services/auth
- PR: https://git.redwood/internal/infra/merge/1234

maria: Terraform snippet:
```
resource "kubernetes_manifest" "auth_ext_secret" {
  manifest = yamldecode(file("manifests/auth-extsecret.yaml"))
  metadata = {
    annotations = {
      "redwood.com/rotation-route" = "svc/auth-sa"
    }
  }
}
```

jon: heads up — our ExternalSecrets controller reads annotations on the ExternalSecret object, not the generated Secret. webhook expects annotation on ExternalSecret or the controller will never forward it.

maria: ah good catch. I put it on the K8s secret resource in the overlay. fixing.

sara: also check the rolebinding. webhook uses a service account token to patch secrets; need `secrets/write` on target namespace. small tf change:
```
resource "kubernetes_role" "extsecret_writer" {
  metadata { namespace = "prod" }
  rule { api_groups = [""] resources = ["secrets"] verbs = ["get","update","patch"] }
}
```

alex: CI is failing on plan — error: unknown field `metadata` in kubernetes_manifest (provider v2.14). maybe use `manifest` only. can you post the actual YAML instead?

maria: pushing YAML instead, updated PR. YAML excerpt:
```
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: auth-credentials
  namespace: prod
  annotations:
    redwood.com/rotation-route: svc/auth-sa
spec:
  refreshInterval: "5m"
  secretStoreRef: { name: redwood-vault }
  target:
    name: auth-credentials
```

infra-bot: CI / terraform plan — success ✅ (build 8421)

jon: one more: rotation window — the webhook dedupes events within 60s, if Vault rotates quickly it can flood. suggest annotation `redwood.com/rotation-window: "2m"` on the ExternalSecret to debounce.

maria: added it. updated PR link: https://git.redwood/internal/infra/merge/1234#diff-2

sara: lgtm for RBAC. alex — can you take the TF lint/plan check? tag me if anything weird.

alex: reviewing now. small nit: namespace interpolation missing in role binding. push fix in a sec.

maria: thanks all. planning a canary apply to staging in 30m, then prod roll at 2am PST if no regressions.

alex: :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Deploy job scheduled: canary/staging (id: 5593) — started by maria

maria: closing thread once staging confirm. thanks!
